changeSet.author: maxcit
changeSet.comment: Column,new: groupId - devices numbered by a rule also join that rule's group. Headwind's own auto-creation has a single global newDeviceGroupId, which cannot express "Kailahun devices go to the Kailahun group".
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE plugin_deviceenroll_rule ADD COLUMN groupId INT REFERENCES groups (id) ON DELETE SET NULL;

changeSet.author: maxcit
changeSet.comment:
Rules are keyed on the group, not the configuration.
An enrollment QR code carries com.hmdm.GROUP alongside com.hmdm.CONFIG - the core panel's own QR page emits "?create=1&group=<id>" - and the launcher passes both back at enrolment. So one configuration can serve any number of groups, each with its own QR code. Keying the rule on the configuration forced a configuration per location, which meant maintaining the same application list in a dozen places.
Rules with no group cannot be addressed by a QR code and are dropped here.
